capabilities: Toggle privacy mode from the command palette, a hotkey, or the status bar
Mask text with hide, blur, or password styles
Reveal text around the cursor by character, word, sentence, or line
Set per-element handling for titles, headers, callouts, and images
Add a transparent, adjustable screen tint while privacy mode is active
disambiguation: It only masks text visually at the display level; it does not encrypt or modify note files.
extras: The README includes a developer-facing release workflow section not relevant to users, and states the plugin is under active development with feedback welcome.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide on-screen note content when working on private writing in public places.
summary: Privacy-mode plugin that visually masks note text in the editor and Reading View while leaving the underlying files unchanged.
